issue.title: Deliberation leaks its scaffold into the reply ('[The candidate is asking…]', 'Verify before giving … as confabulation')
issue.symptom: 2026-10-28 test turn (Claude, session test-578k-*): 'Who wrote Pride and Prejudice?' → deliberation (core_deliberation_v1 adapter, journal cognition-20261028-173313-01) returned, as the user-facing text, a bracketed planning paragraph ('[The candidate is asking about the authorship of a specific literary work. The answer depends on which reference … say which version of the work fits your current context.]') then the answer ('For the novel: Jane Austen.') then a self-instruction ('Verify before giving the other two versions as confabulation.'). The adapter's thinking/scaffold isn't fully separated by _split_think_and_response (scaffold in [brackets], not <think>). The cross-tier audit called it clean — its checklist has no 'internal reasoning shown to the user' item. Related: voice_gate (meta-commentary strip), _extract_draft_from_scaffold.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_deliberation_scaffold_echo_h1ok.py
"""Tests for the scaffold-echo strip (GAIA_Project-h1ok).

Core skips the deliberation <think> block on ~94% of turns; when it does,
pieces of the instructions it was given surface in the reply as if spoken to
the user ("Verify before claiming specifics:", "Did I just emit a deflection
instead of an answer?"). The cases below are taken from real journaled
replies. The strip works by provenance — text copied from the scaffold — so
grounding facts and questions that merely share a phrase are left alone.
"""

from gaia_core.cognition.deliberation import (
    _DELIBERATION_INSTRUCTIONS,
    _scaffold_text,
    _strip_scaffold_echo,
)

SCAFFOLD = _scaffold_text(
    "You are GAIA.\n[Candidate context — automated grounding may be incomplete]\n"
    "Paris is the capital of France.",
    _DELIBERATION_INSTRUCTIONS,
)


def test_drops_copied_instruction_line():
    reply = "Verify before claiming specifics:\n\nThe run finished at 04:10."
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, "when did the run finish?")
    assert dropped == ["Verify before claiming specifics:"]
    assert out == "The run finished at 04:10."


def test_drops_self_critique_question_mid_reply():
    reply = ("I don't have that log in front of me. "
             "Did I just emit a deferral instead of an answer? "
             "The source of truth would be the doctor's status file.")
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, "what did the doctor say?")
    assert len(dropped) == 1
    assert "deferral" not in out
    assert out.startswith("I don't have that log")


def test_drops_echoed_bracketed_header():
    reply = "[Candidate context — automated grounding may be incomplete] Paris is the capital."
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, "capital of france?")
    assert dropped and out == "Paris is the capital."


def test_grounding_facts_are_not_scaffold():
    reply = "Paris is the capital of France. It has been since the 10th century."
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, "capital of france?")
    assert dropped == [] and out == reply


def test_short_question_sharing_a_phrase_is_kept():
    reply = "Good question. What's the source of truth?"
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, "hm")
    assert dropped == [] and out == reply


def test_words_the_user_used_are_not_echo():
    user = "Do you verify before claiming specifics?"
    reply = "I try to verify before claiming specifics. Mostly I succeed."
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, user)
    assert dropped == [] and out == reply


def test_all_echo_reply_is_left_unchanged():
    reply = "Verify before claiming specifics."
    out, dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(reply, SCAFFOLD, "?")
    assert dropped == [] and out == reply

diff --git a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/deliberation.py b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/deliberation.py
index c1f2468..0012bfe 100644
--- a/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/deliberation.py
+++ b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/deliberation.py
@@ -493,6 +493,93 @@ def _strip_leading_input_echo(final_response: str, user_input: str) -> str:
     return rest[0].upper() + rest[1:]
 
 
+# h1ok: when Core skips the <think> block (most turns — see the bead), pieces
+# of the instructions it was given surface in the reply: "Verify before
+# claiming specifics.", or a bracketed header like "[Candidate context — …]".
+# Text copied out of GAIA's own prompt scaffolding is not speech to the user,
+# so it is dropped by provenance, not by vocabulary: a sentence or bracketed
+# span is an echo when most of its word trigrams occur in the scaffold and not
+# in what the user wrote. Grounding facts are deliberately NOT part of the
+# scaffold — quoting a search result is legitimate.
+_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9']+")
+_BRACKET_SPAN_RE = re.compile(r"\[[^\[\]\n]{3,400}\]")
+# Prompt headers are lines that open with "[" — only the header itself (up to
+# its first "]" or ":") counts as scaffold; facts that follow it are content.
+_PROMPT_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[[^\]\n:]{4,160})", re.MULTILINE)
+_ECHO_MIN_WORDS = 4
+_ECHO_OVERLAP = 0.6
+
+
+def _trigrams(text: str) -> set:
+    words = _WORD_RE.findall(text.lower())
+    return {tuple(words[i:i + 3]) for i in range(len(words) - 2)}
+
+
+def _scaffold_text(system_content: str, instructions: str) -> str:
+    """The instruction-like part of the prompt: the deliberation block plus
+    the bracketed section headers prompt_builder wraps context in."""
+    headers = _PROMPT_HEADER_RE.findall(system_content or "")
+    return instructions + "\n" + "\n".join(headers)
+
+
+def _is_echo(piece: str, scaffold_grams: set, user_grams: set) -> bool:
+    words = _WORD_RE.findall(piece.lower())
+    if len(words) < _ECHO_MIN_WORDS:
+        return False
+    grams = _trigrams(piece) - user_grams
+    if not grams:
+        return False
+    # A short piece must be copied whole: "What's the source of truth?" shares
+    # a phrase with the instructions but is a fair question on its own.
+    need = 1.0 if len(grams) < 4 else _ECHO_OVERLAP
+    return len(grams & scaffold_grams) / len(grams) >= need
+
+
+def _strip_scaffold_echo(final_response: str, scaffold: str, user_input: str) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
+    """Drop sentences / bracketed spans of the reply copied from the scaffold.
+
+    Returns (text, dropped). Fail-safe like the voice gate: if nothing
+    substantive would remain, the reply is returned unchanged — an odd reply
+    is better than an empty one.
+    """
+    if not final_response or not scaffold:
+        return final_response, []
+    try:
+        scaffold_grams = _trigrams(scaffold)
+        user_grams = _trigrams(user_input or "")
+        dropped: List[str] = []
+
+        def _span(m: re.Match) -> str:
+            if _is_echo(m.group(0), scaffold_grams, user_grams):
+                dropped.append(m.group(0))
+                return ""
+            return m.group(0)
+
+        text = _BRACKET_SPAN_RE.sub(_span, final_response)
+        kept_lines = []
+        for line in text.split("\n"):
+            parts = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", line)
+            kept = []
+            for p in parts:
+                if p.strip() and _is_echo(p, scaffold_grams, user_grams):
+                    dropped.append(p.strip())
+                else:
+                    kept.append(p)
+            kept_lines.append(" ".join(kept).rstrip())
+        out = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", "\n".join(kept_lines)).strip()
+        if not dropped:
+            return final_response, []
+        if len(_WORD_RE.findall(out.lower())) < 2:
+            logger.info("Deliberation: reply is all scaffold echo; kept as-is (%d pieces)", len(dropped))
+            return final_response, []
+        logger.info("Deliberation: dropped %d scaffold-echo piece(s): %s",
+                    len(dropped), [d[:80] for d in dropped])
+        return out, dropped
+    except Exception:
+        logger.debug("Deliberation: scaffold-echo strip failed (non-fatal)", exc_info=True)
+        return final_response, []
+
+
 # ── Orchestrator ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
 def deliberate(
@@ -599,6 +686,8 @@ def deliberate(
 
     thinking, final_response, fallback_used = _split_think_and_response(raw)
     final_response = _strip_leading_input_echo(final_response, user_input)
+    final_response, _echo_dropped = _strip_scaffold_echo(
+        final_response, _scaffold_text(messages[0].get("content", ""), _instructions), user_input)
     voice_evidence = _detect_voice_evidence(thinking)
     forbidden_hits = _detect_forbidden_phrases(final_response)
     confabulation_flags = _detect_confabulation(final_response)
